baseline_content:
Keep paper towels within easy reach without using wall space—this freestanding paper towel holder keeps the roll upright and stable on your kitchen counter.

Highlights:
- Tear sheets cleanly with less sliding thanks to a weighted base that keeps the stand steady
- Save counter space with an upright, freestanding design that requires no mounting
- Protect countertops from scuffs with a felt pad on the base
- Coordinate your kitchen with the Carolina Collection for a matching Carolina look across your hardware
- Built for everyday use from solid brass with a durable designer finish

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina (traditional/classic styling)
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Freestanding; no assembly required
- Overall size: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H (projection 6.5 in)
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
candidate_content: Built around a weighted base and a scratch-protecting felt pad, this Carolina Collection counter top paper towel stand stays stable as you tear off sheets. {FINISH_SENTENCE} The roll sits upright for a space-saving footprint, giving you a paper towel holder countertop solution that’s freestanding and requires no wall mounting. Crafted from solid brass materials, it’s designed in a classic traditional style with contemporary lines and traditional design elements. The space-saving design makes efficient use of your counter space. The designer finish is specified to provide corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Includes the paper towel holder and requires no assembly. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
